The 2011 Silverado 2500HD LTZ is the premium heavy-duty trim in the Silverado HD lineup, engineered for serious towing and hauling while offering a well-appointed interior. Powered by the Duramax 6.6L turbocharged diesel V8 rated at 397 horsepower and 765 lb-ft of torque, this truck combines strong low-end torque with an Allison heavy-duty automatic transmission for confident performance under load. - Available in two-wheel drive (2WD) and four-wheel drive (4WD) configurations.

Exterior
- LTZ trim styling with bright chrome grille and bumper accents and premium exterior trim.
- Integrated steps, tow hooks (on some configurations), and fog lamps for improved visibility and utility.
- Power exterior mirrors designed for towing; mirrors are typically heated with power adjustment.
- Tailgate and bed designed for heavy use; bed options and liners were available from the factory.

Interior and comfort
- Leather-appointed seating surfaces and higher-grade trim materials befitting the LTZ designation.
- Power-adjustable driver (and typically front passenger) seats; heated front seats commonly included.
- Large center console for storage and organizational convenience.
- Power windows and door locks

This 2009 Honda CR-V EX-L offers practical utility combined with thoughtful comfort features for daily driving and weekend adventures.

- AM/FM/XM Satellite Radio with 6-Disc Audio System
- Leather Seat Trim with Heated Front Seats
- Power Moonroof
- Automatic Temperature Control with Dual Front Zone A/C
- Power Driver Seat with Driver's Seat Mounted Armrest
- Remote Keyless Entry
- Alloy Wheels
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Four Wheel Independent Suspension
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Speed-Sensitive Wipers
- 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS
- Telescoping and Tilt Steering Wheel
- Trip Computer
- Dual Front and Side Impact Airbags with Overhead Airbags

The CR-V's 2.4L I4 DOHC 16V i-VTEC engine delivers capable performance paired with a 5-Speed Automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. With city fuel economy of 20 MPG and highway performance of 27 MPG, this vehicle balances efficiency with everyday practicality.

The interior reflects the EX-L's premium positioning, featuring leather seat trim that wraps heated front bucket seats designed for comfort on longer drives. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the dual zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger maintain their preferred comfort level. Power mirrors, windows, and steering wheel adjustments allow you to customize your driving position quickly.

Entertainment and connectivity are handled by the AM/FM/XM Satellite Radio system with a 6-Disc CD player and seven speakers, controlled conveniently through steering wheel mounted audio controls. The overhead console houses practical storage, while the trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful information at a glance.

Safety is prioritized with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags with occupant sensing technology, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. The four wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections, while electronic stability control, traction control, and speed-sensing steering contribute to confident handling in various driving conditions.

The split folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs, whether transporting passengers or gear. Rear window defroster and wiper ensure visibility in all weather, while the body-color bumpers and alloy wheels maintain the CR-V's refined appearance.

This 2009 CR-V EX-L represents a well-equipped compact crossover ready for the demands of modern driving. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience its capability firsthand.

The extended-range 36-gallon fuel tank is especially valuable for long-distance driving, towing, and busy work schedules by reducing the need for frequent fuel stops. The Bed Utility Package, remote tailgate release, LED side-mirror spotlights, power-sliding rear window, and Tow/Haul equipment add practical capability for owners who regularly use their truck for tools, cargo, trailers, or outdoor equipment.

The Agate Black Metallic exterior is enhanced by King Ranch styling, including a chrome-surround grille with bronze accents, Marsh Gray accent details, 20-inch chrome-like PVD wheels, and 275/60R20 all-terrain tires. LED projector headlamps with dynamic bending capability, LED fog lamps, LED taillamps, chrome exhaust tip, and power-deployable running boards reinforce the truck s premium appearance while adding everyday functionality.

A Twin-Panel Moonroof brings natural light into both rows and gives the spacious SuperCrew cabin an open, upscale atmosphere. Power mirrors, rear privacy glass, and a power-sliding rear window with defroster add convenience, while the SuperCrew configuration provides generous rear-seat space for passengers, coworkers, family members, or protected cargo.

Second-row heated seats extend premium comfort to rear passengers.

Genuine wood accents, a heated leather-wrapped steering wheel, and King Ranch-specific materials create a cabin that feels refined without sacrificing truck utility. The Mobile Office Package adds useful flexibility for drivers who use their F-150 as a workspace, while the large center console and spacious cabin provide room for documents, devices, and everyday essentials.

Technology is centered around SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition and a 12-inch touchscreen. The auto-locking rear differential and integrated trailer brake controller make this truck ready for demanding jobs and confident towing performance.

The WT Convenience Package combines everyday practicality with smart touches like power door locks, remote keyless entry, and a power-adjustable steering column. Heated power-adjustable mirrors adapt to winter conditions, while the EZ Lift tailgate makes loading and securing cargo effortless. The power rear windows drop down with express capability, and the electronic rear-window defogger keeps visibility clear in all weather.

Technology features include the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system with a 3.5-inch monochromatic display, AM/FM radio with radio data system, six speakers, and dual connectivity through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. Bluetooth phone integration keeps communication safe and accessible while driving. Practical conveniences include electronic cruise control, outside temperature display, trip computer, and fully automatic headlights with delay-off function.

Safety and control are reinforced with four-wheel disc brakes, ABS, electronic stability control, traction control, and speed-sensing steering. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and an occupant sensing airbag system provide comprehensive protection. The front wheel independent suspension and heavy-duty suspension setup deliver composed handling and stability under load.

*Certified 2025 Subaru Outback Premium AWD* 2.5L H 4 gasoline direct injection, DOHC, variable valve control, regular unleaded, 182 HP with 8 speed Lineartronic CVT. Recent price change: reduced by $439, making this Certified Outback an even better value for buyers seeking AWD confidence and everyday practicality.

The 2025 Subaru Outback Premium blends rugged capability with commuter-friendly refinement. Its dependable 2.5L boxer four and smooth 8 speed Lineartronic CVT deliver composed acceleration and predictable handling, while standard all wheel drive helps you maintain traction in changing weather. With the recent price drop, this Outback represents a smart balance of capability and cost that suits families, active lifestyles, and drivers who appreciate safe, comfortable travel.

This Outback emphasizes intelligent safety and convenience to keep you relaxed on the road. Hands-on steering assist with lane centering reduces fatigue on longer drives by gently helping you maintain your lane and safe following distance perfect for highway stretches and multi-hour trips. Forward collision mitigation works to recognize sudden slowdowns ahead and readies the vehicle to help avoid or lessen impacts, giving you a proactive layer of protection in busy traffic. Front pedestrian impact prevention adds another level of awareness in urban settings by watching for pedestrians and taking steps to avoid collisions when a risk is detected.

Connectivity and daily usefulness are also prioritized. The built-in mobile hotspot keeps passengers online without burning through phone data, which is especially handy on long drives or when kids need entertainment.
